title: ARGUS source-run cluster paper-to-broker transfer audit verified
summary: ARGUS now prospectively validates paper-emulator versus broker-confirmed impact calibration with complete source_run_id clusters as bootstrap units. This prevents many fills from one session or run from masquerading as many independent experimental units. Metric-eligible rows are grouped inside their execution-evidence class, full clusters are independently resampled, and the plan predeclares cluster/observation minimums, metrics, tolerances, alpha, seed and replicate count before the cohort begins.
evidence: exact-head subsystem-evolution workflow run 36949614712 completed success
Linux and Windows ARGUS/ATHENA/AION causal subsystem jobs passed
cluster field is fixed to source_run_id
minimum eligible clusters and observations are predeclared per evidence kind
complete eligible clusters are resampled rather than individual fills
one-run pseudoreplication fails closed even when many fills exist
zero-fill-only clusters never become invented slippage clusters
broker-confirmed and ICARUS paper-emulator evidence remain separate
formal equivalence, small-sample cluster guarantees, familywise inference, causality, profitability and broker substitution are not implied
